items.title: JetBrains Airとは何か？
items.summary: JetBrains Airは、単体のIDEではなく、Air app、Air in IDEs、Air Teams、Governance、Context、Gatewayを横断するエージェント開発の製品群です。既存のJetBrains IDEで複数エージェントを動かし、Worktree・Docker・クラウド環境で作業を分離しながら、差分、テスト、PRを人間が確認して統合します。エージェントやモデルを選べる柔軟さはある一方、ローカルとクラウドで認証・費用・利用条件が異なり、EAP／Preview機能も混在します。導入時は、品質保証・レビュー負荷・費用・データ境界を含む小規模なPoCで適合性を検証することが重要です。

items.title: What Is JetBrains Air
items.summary: Japanese EditionJetBrains Air is a product system for agentic development, not a standalone IDE. It spans the Air app, Air in IDEs, Air Teams, Governance, Context, and Gateway. Developers can run multiple agents within their existing JetBrains IDEs, isolate work through Git worktrees, Docker, or cloud environments, and then have humans review and integrate diffs, tests, and pull requests. Although Air offers flexibility in choosing agents and models, authentication, pricing, and availability differ between local and cloud environments, and EAP/Preview features are still mixed across the product surfaces. Before adoption, organizations should validate fit through a small proof of concept that considers quality assurance, review overhead, cost, and data boundaries.
